note: Handshake transport only: send an `initialize` request first. This server does NOT yet support the 2026-07-28 era (per-request _meta, server/discover) — a client built for it will receive "Server not initialized". Newest negotiable version: 2025-11-25.
name: lokal
title: Lokal — A2A marketplace for local food in Norway
description: Discover and negotiate with 1904 verified Norwegian food producers. Search by category, region, certification, and trust score. Supports natural-language queries in Norwegian and English.

endpoints.description: Remote MCP HTTP transport. Compatible with ChatGPT connectors and remote Claude.

tools.name: discover_by_category
tools.description: Find producers by category and region.

tools.name: get_producer
tools.description: Fetch full details for a specific producer.

tools.name: register_producer
tools.description: Register a new food producer agent.

authentication.description: Read-only calls (search, discover, get) are open. Write operations require an API key.
